assertions.notes: PDF upload area is a div with role='button', not a file input directly. Upload requires programmatically setting files on a hidden input[type='file'] and dispatching a change event. The 'Expand Email Tools column' sidebar button was intercepting pointer events on the PDF section when the column was collapsed, requiring the column to be expanded first for click interactions to work.

frictions.description: The collapsed 'Email Tools column' sidebar button intercepts pointer events on PDF section elements when the column is collapsed (width: 0 with overflow hidden). Clicking PDF name or remove buttons fails with 'Element is blocked by another element' unless the Email Tools column is expanded first.
frictions.resolution: Expanded the Email Tools column before interacting with PDF section buttons. For PDF name clicks, also used JavaScript click() to bypass Playwright's actionability check.

frictions.description: PDF upload area is a div with role='button', not an HTMLInputElement. The agent-browser 'upload' command requires an input element. Upload required programmatically finding the hidden file input and using DataTransfer API + change event dispatch.
frictions.resolution: Used JavaScript to find the hidden input[type='file'] within the upload container, created a DataTransfer object with a File, set it on the input's files property, and dispatched a change event.

frictions.description: Promotion page redirected to /start when no profile was in localStorage. Profile had to be seeded via JavaScript before testing could proceed.
frictions.resolution: Used agent-browser eval to set localStorage 'userProfile' key with a complete profile JSON object, then navigated to /promotion via React Router.

summary: Tested 6 assertions: all 6 passed. VAL-PROMO-003 (discount entries CRUD + reorder), VAL-PROMO-004 (How to Shop formatting), VAL-PROMO-005 (Important Notes editor), VAL-PROMO-006 (Special Hours editor), VAL-PROMO-008 (PDF upload/remove/preview), VAL-PROMO-009 (subject line generation/selection/editing). No console errors observed. Minor frictions with collapsed column intercepting clicks and hidden file input for PDF uploads were resolved during testing.
